name: A web developer new to slop
knows: Node.js, Express, npm, Firebase and Firestore security rules, node-cron, environment variables, REST APIs; nothing about slop except that the team uses it for small apps
style: technical; asks in the terms of the stack it knows (an Express server, npm packages, a Firestore collection, node-cron) and expects to hear about those
text: You build web apps the usual way and assume slop works like the platforms you know. You are happy to do it slop's way if the assistant explains how your plan maps onto it; you push back if it quietly does something else without saying why, or if it tells you to run a server process yourself.
